"""Serial offline reporting checks for the dated documentary recovery."""

import json
import os
import resource
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

case = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
root = case.parents[1]
os.chdir(root)
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS, (512 * 1024 * 1024,) * 2)
for name in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS", "NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS", "RAYON_NUM_THREADS"):
    os.environ[name] = "1"
ruff = "/fast_data/home/liliana/miniconda3/envs/molsyssuite@uibcdf_3.14/bin/ruff"
commands = [
    [sys.executable, "-B", "devtools/devguide_index.py"],
    [sys.executable, "-B", "devtools/devguide_index.py", "--check"],
    [sys.executable, "-B", "-m", "unittest", "discover", "-s", "tests", "-p", "test_reporting_protocol.py"],
    [sys.executable, "-B", "-m", "unittest", "discover", "-s", "tests", "-p", "test_evidence_archive.py"],
    [sys.executable, "-B", "-m", "devtools.evidence_archive", "devguide/evidence/brd4_pdf_recovery_20261106_summary.json"],
    [ruff, "check", "--no-cache", "."],
    [ruff, "format", "--check", "--no-cache", "."],
    ["git", "diff", "--check"],
]
results = []
for command in commands:
    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120, check=False)
    record = {"command": command, "exit_code": result.returncode, "stdout": result.stdout, "stderr": result.stderr}
    results.append(record)
    print(json.dumps(record), flush=True)
    if result.returncode:
        break
with (case / "validation_results.json").open("x") as stream:
    json.dump({"commands": results, "resources": {"affinity": sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)), "nice": os.getpriority(os.PRIO_PROCESS, 0), "address_space_limit_bytes": resource.getrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS)[0], "backend_threads": 1, "serial": True, "no_swap_cgroup_claim": False}}, stream, indent=2)
    stream.write("\n")
raise SystemExit(any(result["exit_code"] for result in results))

verify_closeout_integrity.py.utf8:
"""Verify frozen own artifacts and local targets of changed Markdown links."""

import gzip
import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit

case = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
root = case.parents[1]
summary_path = root / "devguide/evidence/brd4_pdf_recovery_20261106_summary.json"
summary = json.loads(summary_path.read_text())
identity = summary["full_evidence"]
packed = (summary_path.parent / identity["path"]).read_bytes()
raw = gzip.decompress(packed)
for prefix, data in (("compressed", packed), ("uncompressed", raw)):
    assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == identity[prefix + "_sha256"]
    assert len(data) == identity[prefix + "_bytes"]
report = json.loads(raw)
for name, file_identity in report["files"].items():
    assert ".private." not in Path(name).name
    blob = report["utf8_blobs_by_sha256"][file_identity["sha256"]].encode()
    assert hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest() == file_identity["sha256"]
    assert len(blob) == file_identity["bytes"]
    assert (root / name).read_bytes() == blob
for name, digest in summary["source_plan_files"].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((root / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest

changed = subprocess.check_output(["git", "diff", "--name-only", "--", "*.md"], cwd=root, text=True).splitlines()
new = subprocess.check_output(["git", "ls-files", "--others", "--exclude-standard", "--", "*.md"], cwd=root, text=True).splitlines()
pages = sorted(set(changed + new))
checked = 0
errors = []
for name in pages:
    path = root / name
    for match in re.finditer(r"\[[^\]]*\]\((<[^>]+>|[^\s)]+)(?:\s+[^)]*)?\)", path.read_text()):
        link = match.group(1).strip("<>")
        if urlsplit(link).scheme or link.startswith(("#", "//")):
            continue
        target = unquote(link.split("#", 1)[0].split("?", 1)[0])
        if not target:
            continue
        checked += 1
        resolved = (path.parent / target).resolve()
        if not resolved.exists():
            errors.append({"page": name, "target": target})
result = {"own_archived_files_verified": len(report["files"]), "source_plan_hashes_verified": len(summary["source_plan_files"]), "changed_markdown_pages_checked": len(pages), "local_links_checked": checked, "link_errors": errors, "private_original_bodies_excluded": True, "archive_identity_verified": True, "link_scope": "Local target existence only; anchors and external links not revalidated"}
with (case / "integrity_and_links.json").open("x") as stream:
    json.dump(result, stream, indent=2)
    stream.write("\n")
print(json.dumps(result))
assert not errors
